title: HAS (Hostel Affairs Secretary)
summary: CMGFS, MMCC (mess), Sustainability Committee, Design & Media, HASEC; whom to contact.

posts.md:
The **Hostel Affairs Secretary (HAS)** is the primary student representative for all matters related to hostel life at IIT Madras.

The HAS works with the Hostel Management to improve hostel facilities, dining services, residential amenities, sustainability initiatives, and student welfare. The office also represents students in matters related to hostel services and campus vendors.

This guide provides an overview of the student bodies that function under the Hostel Affairs Secretary.

## Contents

Committee for Monitoring General Facilities for Students (CMGFS)

Mess Monitoring & Controlling Committee (MMCC)

Sustainability Committee (SusCom)

Design & Media Team

Hostel Affairs Executive Committee (HASEC)

## Committee for Monitoring General Facilities for Students (CMGFS)

CMGFS works to improve the quality of student facilities and services available across the hostel zones.

### Responsibilities

Monitor campus shops and essential services

Evaluate vendors and identify new commercial services

Address student complaints regarding facilities

Conduct price comparisons

Review food outlets and menu options

Organize Cycle Melas

Support vendor arrangements during Hostel Nights

CMGFS regularly inspects facilities to ensure students receive quality services at fair prices.

**Instagram:** @cmgfs_iitm

## Mess Monitoring & Controlling Committee (MMCC)

MMCC works to improve the dining experience across hostel messes.

### Responsibilities

Mess menu planning

Hygiene inspections

Food quality monitoring

Student feedback collection

Food waste reduction

Coordination with catering teams

The committee continuously works with students and mess operators to improve food quality, variety, and dining facilities.

## Sustainability Committee (SusCom)

SusCom promotes sustainable living and environmentally friendly practices across the hostels.

### Activities

Waste management initiatives

Sustainability awareness campaigns

Collaboration with hostel teams

Inter-Hostel Sustainability Showdown

Green campus initiatives

## Design & Media Team

The Design & Media Team creates promotional and creative content for all Hostel Affairs initiatives.

### Responsibilities

Posters & graphics

Photography

Promotional videos

Awareness campaigns

Social media content

The team supports CMGFS, MMCC, SusCom, and other Hostel Affairs initiatives by communicating important updates to students.

## Hostel Affairs Executive Committee (HASEC)

HASEC provides executive support to the Hostel Affairs Secretary in implementing hostel policies and improving student life.

### Focus Areas

Hostel administration

Student grievances

Policy implementation

Coordination between hostel committees

New hostel initiatives

## When Should You Contact These Teams?

**CMGFS**

- Problems with campus shops

- Vendor complaints

- Service quality issues

- Suggestions for new facilities
**MMCC**

- Mess food quality

- Menu suggestions

- Hygiene concerns

- Dining feedback
**SusCom**

- Sustainability ideas

- Recycling initiatives

- Environmental campaigns
**HASEC**

- Hostel-related grievances

- Residential concerns

- General hostel welfare

- Suggestions for improving hostel life

**Did you know?**

From **hostel food and campus shops** to **sustainability initiatives, residential facilities, and student grievances**, the Hostel Affairs teams work every day to improve the quality of hostel life at IIT Madras. If you have suggestions or face issues in your hostel, these committees are your first point of contact.
